title: 3D relief map with live DOM pins and weather cards
blurb: A procedural WebGL 2 relief island with real-time sun hillshading and contour lines, carrying four live HTML weather cards in 3D space. Orbit the map, move the sun, switch between billboard and flat cards, and click or type inside each card.
question: Can a procedural WebGL 2 relief terrain map with real-time sun shading anchor live interactive HTML weather and waypoint cards in 3D space so they project, depth-scale, cast shadows on the terrain, and still take clicks and typing?
result: Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context with terrain-conformed ground shadows, back-to-front card sorting and projective updateElementGeometry() hit boxes. Live browser verification is not run yet.
